messages:
flo.docs: opening a tiny PR to compress the onboarding 'hello-minima' quickstart into a single-pane flow: auth, one minimal request, and a deploy button. draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/720

marc: love the shrink. please standardize env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY and include curl + node + py one-liners. keep examples to 2-3 lines max.

flo.docs: switched to REDWOOD_API_KEY and added three micro-examples. curling example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \\
  -d '{"model":"gpt-mini","input":"Hi"}'
```

anya: tiny copy ask: remove deep perf sections and link to Optimize. add one-sentence token-scope note (generation vs embeddings) and a CORS blurb for browser demos.

flo.docs: removed perf paragraph, added token-scope one-liner and CORS note: "Browser tryouts should use the hosted playground or a backend proxy to avoid exposing tokens."

spell-bot: spelling check: "enviroment" in step 2.

flo.docs: fixed typo, thanks.

marc: also bump Docker base to node:20 in the repo example and make example responses compact JSON (so they render inline).

flo.docs: Docker base updated, example response compacted to {"id":"r_min","output":"Hello"}. added troubleshooting FAQ for 401s:
```
# 401? ensure REDWOOD_API_KEY set:
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_test_xxx
# windows: set REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_test_xxx
```

ci-bot: linkcheck failed: broken link -> /docs/legacy/deploy.html

flo.docs: swapped with /docs/deploy/buttons and updated the deploy badge to /deploy?repo=redwood-inference/hello-minima. pushing fix.

ci-bot: CI passed for PR #720 (checks: mdx-compile, lint, linkcheck) :white_check_mark:

marc: one editorial nit: use "deploy button" wording (not "one-click"). otherwise LGTM.

flo.docs: done. merging after CI. thanks! :rocket:

deploy-bot: PR #720 merged by flo.docs  staging deploy queued.
